tools.name: build
tools.summary: Build a FreeCAD feature tree from a bounded parametric recipe; save FCStd, STEP and STL, then reopen in a separate process.

tools.name: inspect
tools.summary: Read a project FCStd/STEP, report geometry and export FCStd/STEP/STL through the persistent runtime. FCStd accepts only the supported native feature types, with no Python proxies or expressions.

tools.name: export
tools.summary: Read a project FCStd/STEP, report geometry and export FCStd/STEP/STL through the persistent runtime. FCStd accepts only the supported native feature types, with no Python proxies or expressions.

tools.name: edit
tools.summary: Modify a hash-bound recipe for an existing generated FCStd/STEP in a new Action; preserve the original model. Changes may update named parameters or dimensions/profile/origin of known feature IDs.

skills.summary: Persistent FreeCAD tools, parametric recipes and independent geometry readback.
